title: Combined Genotype Effects of TP53 and PAI-1 Polymorphisms in Breast Cancer Susceptibility: Multifactor Dimensionality Reduction and in silico Analysis.
authors: Pouladi, Nasser; Shavali, Mojtaba; Abdolahi, Sepehr
one_liner_zh: 该文研究乳腺癌中TP53和PAI-1多态性的基因-基因交互作用，使用MDR和in silico分析，但核心是SNP统计关联，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Breast cancer is a heterogeneous and multifactorial disease. TP53 and PAI-1 as important tumor suppressor genes are involved in the development, invasion, and metastasis of many cancers. This study's objective was to demonstrate the combined genotype effects of these 2 genes by investigating their single nucleotide polymorphisms. METHODS: In this case-control study, 200 individuals with breast cancer and 179 healthy individuals were studied. The genotypes were determined using the tetra-ARMS method. For data analysis, MDR, online javstat statistics package, and SPSS v.24 software were used. Also, in silico studies on the estimated effects of each of these polymorphisms were performed. RESULTS: We showed a novel gene-gene interaction of these 2 genes and demonstrated a strong synergistic interaction for TP53/PAI-1, moderate synergistic interaction for PAI-1/age, and correlation for TP53/age. On the other hand, there was no association between the allelic and genotype frequency alone and in combination, with case-control status, using the parametric method, between TP53 and PAI-1. DISCUSSION/CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that the polymorphism of codon 72 of the TP53 gene was significantly associated with tumor stage (p < 0.023). In conclusion, we showed a gene-gene interaction between TP53 and PAI-1, in combination, using the MDR method.
abstract_zh: 引言：乳腺癌是一种异质性且多因素导致的疾病。TP53和PAI-1作为重要的肿瘤抑制基因，参与多种癌症的发生、侵袭和转移。本研究旨在通过探讨这两个基因的单核苷酸多态性，展示其联合基因型效应。方法：在本病例对照研究中，纳入了200名乳腺癌患者和179名健康个体。使用四引物扩增 refractory mutation system (tetra-ARMS) 方法确定基因型。数据分析采用MDR、在线javastat统计软件包和SPSS v.24软件。此外，还对每个多态性的预估效应进行了计算机模拟 (in silico) 研究。结果：我们揭示了这两个基因的新型基因-基因相互作用，并展示了TP53/PAI-1的强协同作用、PAI-1/年龄的中等协同作用以及TP53/年龄的相关性。另一方面，使用参数方法，在TP53和PAI-1的等位基因和基因型频率单独或组合与病例对照状态之间未发现关联。讨论/结论：我们的研究结果表明，TP53基因第72位密码子的多态性与肿瘤分期显著相关（p < 0.023）。总之，我们通过MDR方法展示了TP53和PAI-1在组合中的基因-基因相互作用。
